sources.title: Codex Factory self-contained evidence
sources.note: Codex Factory has built its own agent OS with 8 roles, event bus, lifecycle, authority matrix, handoff protocols

findings.relevance: Factory already has agent infrastructure; role specialization is the next layer, not replacing the agent OS
findings.keyFinding: Existing multi-agent frameworks (AutoGen, CrewAI, Swarm) differ in agent communication model. Codex Factory's agent OS (8 roles, event bus, authority matrix) is self-contained and not dependent on external frameworks.

sources.title: Codex Factory H13-C evidence
sources.note: Real spawn_agent test with fork_context:false proven

findings.relevance: Any role-specialized agent model must use spawn_agent, not thread/fork as carrier
findings.keyFinding: Codex spawn_agent with fork_context:false proven for builders; fork_context:true proven for explorers. 6 subagents active in current session. Subagent is NOT a user-visible branch or session carrier.

sources.title: Codex Factory plugin structure
sources.note: Plugin scaffold exists with skills, MCP prototype, references

findings.relevance: Role-specific skills could be created; current skills are factory-internal
findings.keyFinding: Codex supports skills (SKILL.md), plugins (.codex-plugin/plugin.json), and MCP servers. Factory has a codex-factory-plugin with experimental scaffolding. Skills are generic (not role-specific).

sources.title: LR8 carrier capability probe
sources.note: Thread tools exist but untested for live carrier

findings.relevance: Do not design role-agent model around unverified carrier capabilities
findings.keyFinding: Thread/fork/new/resume tools exist in Codex Desktop schema but are HYPOTHESIS for session carrier use. Automation same-thread wakeup is REJECTED as carrier.

sources.title: Codex Factory governance model
sources.note: Factory has self-governance but no external company-model references

findings.relevance: Role model should map to verifiable outputs, not just role claims
findings.keyFinding: Role specialization (PM/architect/engineer/QA/security/DevOps) is a common pattern in one-person AI companies. Key risk: agent drift without human oversight. Factory's verifier/negative control system partially addresses this.

sources.title: Codex Factory context OS
sources.note: Context OS with memory index, 5 ledgers, context packets, query protocol

findings.relevance: Manual router must not assume 'Codex read it once = Codex knows it' — proof-of-read is still required
findings.confidence: MEDIUM — partially supported by repo design
findings.keyFinding: Long-context models (1M tokens) do not eliminate need for external memory and routing. Context is not comprehension. Factory's Context OS + MCP Memory approach of external indexing + query is complementary, not replaced by long context.
